title: Coverage Reporting
description: Visualize coverage results and set meaningful thresholds.

data.text: **Coverage reporting** transforms raw coverage data into actionable insights. Use reports to identify untested code and enforce coverage thresholds in CI.

data.title: Coverage Reporting Workflow
items: Export coverage in a supported format
Generate HTML or badge reports with ReportGenerator
Review uncovered lines and add targeted tests
Set minimum coverage thresholds in CI

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Make coverage reporting part of your development workflow.
